blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no FOREX-NG4 scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers were read (none exist; none were computed); no backtest executed; no keyed API call made. Only timing, availability, coverage and count evidence from the pinned P0c wide-window census (sha256 6471b8bed8ccf04c9163318fd27b8c4bc407d57d6d3fd6cdc10acd768250cdeb, re-measured/re-hashed at this checkout), the p0b superseded census, the p0 EURUSD integrity census, the P0 gate, and the CLOSED prior-cycle terminal evidence (FOREX-NG1/NG2/NG3 terminal reports and research/wayfinder/FAMILY_FAILURES.jsonl - frozen ancestry inventory, not this cycle's outcomes) was consumed. The revision-gap SIGNS of the 16 differential months are NOT measured anywhere in the consumed evidence and were NOT computed: the fired-count estimates below are BLIND priors and the sign-opposition share of the 16 months is an unmeasured quantity at proposal time.

mechanism.story: Eurostat and the BLS revise their price-index vintages. Each RESTRICTED first-print revision event (ng2/ng3 census law: v1->v2 vintage gap on the same obs month, full realtime windows, first-print era, no bulk re-referencing group) is a public correction of already-published inflation information. EURUSD prices RELATIVE inflation between the euro area and the United States: when BOTH agencies revise in the SAME obs month (the census join), the quote-relevant object is the DIFFERENCE between the corrections. Among co-revision months, the month where the two agencies revise in OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS is the maximal relative-inflation event: the EZ and US information sets diverge in the same month, the relative revision cannot be a shared global artifact, and any relative-inflation repricing logic (real-rate path, PPP drift, terms-of-trade) is pushed in exactly one direction. Slow money - monthly dealing-cycle benchmark rebalancers, calendar-fixing corporate hedgers, real-money relative-value books - does not re-derive relative-inflation positions off vintage-gap signs in real time; their delayed implementation lands at scheduled windows inside the horizon this lane can provably observe, after BOTH v2 vintages are evidenced-available.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) monthly dealing-cycle real-money accounts implement relative-inflation updates only after the month's revision evidence completes on BOTH sides of the pair and only at scheduled windows - structurally late relative to the max-v2 availability sequence; (ii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: entry requires the evidenced vintaged availability of BOTH legs' v2 vintages - A(m) = max(v2_EZ day, v2_US day), date-only evidence with the conservative 23:59:59Z bound - which the pinned archives show arriving weeks-to-months after the obs month (ng3 census samples of the same class: obs 2017-11 v1 2018-01-02 -> v2 2018-10-09; the ng2/ng3-era US archive carries small monthly index-level vintage updates ~12/year). The hypothesis is specifically that the sign-opposition-conditioned repricing SURVIVES the PIT-provable max-v2 availability lag plus the 5-grid-day holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_differential_not_ppp: DECLARED DEFENSE vs the lane's kill-candidate #1 (V9 PPP-deviation, rho 0.3034/0.3119). The V9 A5 books were LEVEL-misalignment books: a persistent, slowly-decaying relative-PRICE-LEVEL state (EURUSD spot vs the PPP-implied level from vintaged CPI index LEVELS), traded TOWARD reversion, and measurably a nominal-yield-level exposure in disguise. This proposal is an EVENT-time CHANGE differential: (i) OBJECT - the v1->v2 revision gap R_X(m), a flow that exists only in co-revision months, arrives at a dated instant, is two-sided and magnitude-blind here (sign-only statistic), and has lifetime one event; a level state cannot represent it (two months with IDENTICAL relative price levels can carry opposite sign-opposition states); (ii) COMPOSITION - the US leg is SUBTRACTED: the common global price-cycle and methodology-wave component that contaminated the PPP relative levels (and made them nominal-level shadows, rho 0.3034 vs the V8 anchor) is stripped BY CONSTRUCTION - in sign-opposition months the common component is provably absent (the legs cannot share a driver and still oppose); (iii) STATE - the firing state requires the census JOIN (both agencies restricted-revising the same obs month), a calendar structure no PPP/level book carries; (iv) ECONOMY - the EZ leg was NEVER anchored anywhere in program history (plan sec 1-2): every prior inflation-differential death (ng3-A5 on CA) sat on CA-vs-bloc, never EZ-vs-US. The distinction is ALSO carried as a mandatory measurement: CTL-PPPANCESTRY runs the absolute-EZ inflation-LEVEL form (cumulative absolute-EZ surprise path, reversion-traded, no US anywhere) on the identical fired book - if it reproduces the anchor, the book is the dead PPP/level class re-clocked onto the revision clock and the family dies by law (accepted in advance); and the D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 gate applies vs the V9 veto books explicitly.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (after-cost per-trade expectancy <= 0) if EURUSD's post-joint-availability windows carry no opposition-signed drift. It must die by falsification if the absolute-EZ inflation-LEVEL form reproduces it (CTL-PPPANCESTRY - the PPP-deviation re-clock kill, kill-candidate #1 of this lane); if the EZ revision reaction-DIRECTION alone reproduces it without the opposition conditioning (CTL-V7NODIFF - the V7 closure; the EXACT control class that killed ng3-A5-P1 at rho 1.0 self-subsumption); if a nominal-yield-level exposure reproduces it (CTL-DGS10LEVEL; V8 law; the control that killed ng1-A4-P2, cluster #15); if a constant-direction calendar shadow reproduces it (SHADOW-CLOCK, Q-7); if a sign-permuted book reproduces it (PLACEBO); if the sign-AGREEMENT complement parameterization out-earns the opposition construction (NEIGH-SIGNAGREE); or at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 vs the full inventory including the V9 PPP vetoes, the ng1 books and the ng3-A5 differential books (accepted in advance).

differential_construction.anchor_form: SIGN-DIFF construction: the anchor state is the sign configuration of the two legs. sign(R_X) is always defined on restricted events (the event exists iff the v1->v2 gap is nonzero). A differential month fires iff OPPOSITION: sign(R_EZ(m)) != sign(R_US(m)). Direction = sign(R_EZ(m) - R_US(m)), which in an opposed month equals sign(R_EZ(m)) by construction. universe.direction_law: OPPOSED month with R_EZ > 0 and R_US < 0 => EZ revised up while US revised down => relative EZ inflation path up => LONG EURUSD. OPPOSED month with R_EZ < 0 and R_US > 0 => the mirror (SHORT EURUSD). AGREED month (same signs) => no position (that is the neighbour's construction). Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias.
